name: four-hour-block-four-hour-spacing
rationale: The 2026-09-25 report found the diagnostic-capital throttling curve still rising at 7200/7200 (500,000 JPY Sharpe +3.00 vs +1.51 at 1800/3600), and 2026-09-28's 7200/3600 gave a little of that back (+2.44), i.e. longer spacing has helped every time it was lengthened and the peak has not been located. This doubles both knobs to 14400s (signal held four hours, at most one rebalance per four hours) to find where the curve turns. Expected to cut trades further at 50,000 JPY and so likely fail the trade-count criterion against a non-degenerate baseline; it is run anyway because locating the optimum at the 500,000 JPY target capital is the information the operator needs for the pending promotion-capital decision (2026-09-28 lead #1). Report per capital; score on total_fees_jpy and the promotion rule.
